name: Salmon Piccata
steps: Sear salmon in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Add garlic, broth, lemon juice, capers; simmer 2 minutes; whisk in butter.
Spoon over salmon; serve with roasted asparagus and parsley.

name: Shrimp & Avocado Cucumber Rolls
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; chop.
Lay cucumber ribbons overlapping; spread cream cheese; add shrimp and avocado.
Roll tightly; slice; sprinkle sesame and chives; serve with tamari.

name: Swordfish Steaks with Salsa Verde
steps: Blend parsley, capers, anchovy, garlic, lemon, most of the oil, Dijon into salsa verde.
Brush swordfish with remaining oil; grill 4 minutes per side.
Serve over arugula with salsa verde.

name: Shrimp Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop centers.
Sauté chopped shrimp with garlic and zucchini flesh; mix with marinara.
Fill boats; top cheeses; bake at 400°F 18 minutes; add basil.

name: Mackerel with Roasted Beets & Mustard Yogurt
steps: Roast beets wrapped in foil 40 minutes; peel and slice.
Broil mackerel with oil and salt 8 minutes.
Mix yogurt, Dijon, dill, lemon; serve fish with beets, greens and sauce.

name: Clams with Garlic, White Wine & Zoodles
steps: Sauté garlic in oil; add wine and clams; cover 5 minutes until open.
Add zoodles; toss 2 minutes.
Finish with parsley, lemon, pepper flakes.

name: Shrimp Cobb Lettuce Wraps
steps: Sauté shrimp; crisp bacon; boil eggs.
Mix yogurt, blue cheese, lemon.
Fill lettuce with shrimp, egg, bacon, avocado, tomato; drizzle.

name: Salmon Stir-Fry with Ginger & Green Beans
steps: Sear salmon cubes in oil 3 minutes; remove.
Stir-fry green beans, pepper, ginger, garlic 4 minutes.
Return salmon with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; top sesame.

name: Fish Curry (Coconut, Kerala-Style)
steps: Sizzle mustard seeds in oil; add onion, garlic, ginger, spices.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 8 minutes.
Add cod and spinach; cook 6 minutes; finish with lime, cilantro.

name: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with Chimichurri
steps: Skewer shrimp and zucchini chunks; brush with a third of the oil; grill 3 minutes per side.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes.
Spoon chimichurri over skewers.

name: Tuna Melt Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve and seed peppers.
Mix tuna, yogurt, Dijon, celery, green onion; fill peppers.
Top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Salmon Kale Caesar Wrap
steps: Roast salmon; flake.
Toss chopped kale with yogurt, lemon, Dijon, parmesan.
Roll salmon and kale in tortillas.

name: Shrimp Coconut Cauliflower Rice
steps: Sauté cauliflower rice with coconut milk, garlic, ginger 6 minutes.
Sauté shrimp with jalapeño in oil 3 minutes.
Combine; finish with lime, green onion, cilantro.

name: Herb-Crusted Halibut with Ratatouille
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, eggplant, zucchini, pepper in oil 10 minutes; add tomato, thyme; simmer 15 minutes.
Press almond flour-parmesan-basil onto halibut; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.
Serve fish over ratatouille.

name: Shrimp & White Bean Skillet with Spinach
steps: Sauté garlic in oil; add tomatoes 2 minutes.
Add shrimp 3 minutes; add beans and spinach until wilted.
Finish with lemon, parsley, pepper flakes.

name: Salmon Sheet Pan with Broccoli & Sweet Potato
steps: Roast sweet potato cubes with half the oil 15 minutes.
Add broccoli and salmon rubbed with garlic, paprika, remaining oil; roast 15 minutes more.
Finish with lemon.

name: Shrimp Tom Yum-Style Bowl
steps: Simmer broth with lemongrass, ginger, jalapeño 8 minutes.
Add mushrooms and tomato 3 minutes; add shrimp 3 minutes.
Add fish sauce, lime; pour over zoodles; top cilantro.

name: Sea Bass with Fennel & Citrus
steps: Roast sliced fennel with half the oil at 425°F 12 minutes.
Add sea bass, orange slices, olives, garlic, thyme, remaining oil; roast 12 minutes.
Serve with pan juices.

name: Shrimp Cauliflower Grits Bowl with Kale
steps: Blend steamed cauliflower with milk, cheddar, salt.
Sauté kale with half the garlic; sauté shrimp with remaining garlic and Old Bay.
Bowl grits, kale, shrimp; finish lemon, green onion.

name: Salmon Avocado Sushi Stack
steps: Roast or sear salmon; flake. Steam and cool cauliflower rice seasoned with vinegar.
In a ring mold layer cauliflower rice, avocado, cucumber, salmon; unmold.
Top with nori strips, sesame, green onion, tamari, sriracha.

name: Trout Amandine with Green Beans
steps: Sear trout in oil 3 minutes per side; remove.
Toast sliced almonds in butter; add lemon juice and parsley.
Spoon over trout; serve with green beans.

name: Shrimp Fried 'Rice' with Kimchi
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in oil; remove.
Stir-fry kimchi and cauliflower rice 5 minutes; scramble eggs in.
Return shrimp with tamari, gochujang, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Cod Cakes with Lemon Dill Sauce
steps: Mix flaked cod, eggs, almond flour, green onion, Dijon, Old Bay; form 8 cakes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, dill, lemon; serve cakes over arugula.

name: Shrimp Primavera with Chickpea Pasta
steps: Cook pasta al dente.
Sauté garlic, asparagus, zucchini 4 minutes; add shrimp and tomatoes 3 minutes; add peas.
Toss with pasta, lemon, parmesan, basil.

name: Salmon Poke Lettuce Cups
steps: Cube salmon; toss with tamari, sesame oil, vinegar, green onion.
Fill lettuce cups with poke, avocado, cucumber, seaweed.
Sprinkle sesame.

name: Baked Snapper with Tomatoes & Herbs
steps: Place snapper in a dish with tomatoes, zucchini, garlic; drizzle oil, wine, lemon; season.
Bake at 400°F 15–18 minutes.
Top with basil.

name: Shrimp Caesar Zoodle Bowl
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, anchovy, garlic, oil.
Toss zoodles and romaine with dressing; top shrimp and parmesan.

name: Salmon Tacos with Chipotle Yogurt
steps: Rub salmon with spices and oil; broil 8 minutes; flake.
Mix yogurt with minced chipotle and lime.
Fill tortillas with cabbage, salmon, avocado, chipotle yogurt, cilantro.

name: Shrimp Spinach Artichoke Skillet
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in oil; remove.
Wilt spinach; add artichokes, cream cheese, yogurt, parmesan; stir until creamy.
Return shrimp; finish with lemon.

name: Grilled Tuna with Avocado & Tomato Salad
steps: Brush tuna with oil; grill 2 minutes per side.
Toss avocado, tomato, onion, basil, capers with lemon and oil.
Slice tuna; serve with salad.

name: Almond-Crusted Catfish with Collards
steps: Simmer collards with onion, garlic, broth, vinegar 20 minutes.
Dip catfish in egg then almond flour-Cajun; pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve with collards and hot sauce.

name: Shrimp & Mango Lettuce Cups
steps: Sauté shrimp with cumin 3 minutes; cool slightly.
Toss with mango, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime, avocado.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Oven-Roasted Sardines with Lemon & Greens
steps: Rub sardines with oil, garlic, salt; roast at 425°F 10–12 minutes.
Toss arugula and tomato with lemon.
Serve sardines over the salad with parsley.

name: Shrimp Boil Sheet Pan (Low-Carb)
steps: Toss potatoes with half the oil and Old Bay; roast 15 minutes.
Add zucchini, sausage, corn, shrimp, remaining oil, garlic; roast 10 minutes.
Drizzle melted butter and lemon; parsley.

name: Salmon with Cucumber Dill Yogurt
steps: Roast salmon with oil and salt 12 minutes.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, dill, garlic, lemon.
Serve salmon over greens with sauce.

name: Scallop & Asparagus Stir-Fry
steps: Sear scallops in oil 90 seconds per side; remove.
Stir-fry asparagus, garlic, ginger 3 minutes.
Return scallops with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; green onion.

name: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas; simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in spinach; finish lime, cilantro; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Press tofu; cube; toss with arrowroot; pan-fry in oil until crisp; remove.
Stir-fry vegetables, garlic, ginger 5 minutes.
Return tofu with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; top sesame.

name: Black Bean Burgers (Lettuce Bun)
steps: Mash beans; mix with oats, egg, onion, garlic, spices, salt; form 4 patties; chill 15 minutes.
Pan-fry in oil 5 minutes per side.
Serve in lettuce with avocado, tomato, salsa.

name: Lentil Bolognese over Zoodles
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms, garlic in oil 8 minutes.
Add wine, tomatoes, lentils, seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parmesan.

name: Eggplant Parmesan (Baked, Almond Crust)
steps: Slice eggplant; salt 15 minutes; blot. Dip in egg then almond flour-parmesan-seasoning; bake at 425°F 20 minutes.
Layer with marinara and mozzarella in a dish.
Bake at 375°F 20 minutes; top basil.

name: Tempeh Taco Bowls
steps: Crumble tempeh; sauté in oil with seasoning and tamari 8 minutes until browned.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with beans, pico, avocado, romaine, lime, cilantro.

name: Cauliflower Crust Veggie Pizza
steps: Microwave cauliflower rice 5 minutes; cool; squeeze dry. Mix with eggs, 80 g mozzarella, parmesan, almond flour, seasoning.
Press into a round on parchment; bake at 425°F 20 minutes until golden.
Top with marinara, vegetables, remaining mozzarella; bake 12 minutes; basil.

name: Mushroom & Spinach Stuffed Portobellos with Quinoa
steps: Brush caps with oil and balsamic; roast 8 minutes.
Sauté chopped mushrooms, garlic, spinach; mix with quinoa, walnuts, thyme.
Fill caps; top goat cheese; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Tofu Coconut Curry
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes in oil until golden; remove.
Fry curry paste, garlic, ginger; add coconut milk, vegetables; simmer 8 minutes.
Return tofu; add tamari, lime, basil; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Avocado Pesto & White Beans
steps: Blend avocado, basil, garlic, lemon, oil, pine nuts, salt into pesto.
Warm zoodles 2 minutes; toss with pesto.
Add beans and tomatoes.

name: Shakshuka with Chickpeas
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic with spices in oil 7 minutes.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas, harissa; simmer 10 minutes.
Crack in eggs; cover 7 minutes; top feta, parsley.

name: Greek Stuffed Peppers with Quinoa & Feta
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Mix quinoa, chickpeas, chopped spinach, olives, tomato, garlic, oregano, lemon, oil, half the feta.
Fill peppers; top remaining feta; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Crispy Baked Tofu with Broccoli & Peanut Sauce
steps: Toss tofu cubes with arrowroot and half the oil; roast at 425°F 25 minutes with broccoli tossed in remaining oil.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, ginger, sriracha, warm water.
Drizzle sauce; top green onion, peanuts.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; add lentils, tomato paste, broth, thyme, peas; simmer 10 minutes.
Mash steamed cauliflower with butter, milk, parmesan, salt.
Top filling with mash; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice with Edamame
steps: Scramble eggs in oil; remove.
Stir-fry carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes.
Add edamame, eggs, tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Baked Falafel with Tahini & Cucumber Salad
steps: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices, baking powder, almond flour, salt; form 16 balls; brush with oil.
Bake at 425°F 22 minutes, flipping once.
Whisk tahini, lemon, water; serve with cucumber-tomato salad.

name: Spaghetti Squash Primavera
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes; scrape.
Sauté garlic and vegetables 5 minutes; add beans.
Toss with squash, lemon, parmesan, basil.

name: Caprese Stuffed Portobellos
steps: Brush caps with oil and garlic; roast 8 minutes.
Fill with halved tomato, mozzarella, beans; bake 10 minutes.
Top basil and balsamic.

name: Tofu Scramble Burrito Bowl
steps: Crumble tofu; sauté with turmeric, cumin, nutritional yeast, pepper 6 minutes.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with beans, salsa, avocado, cilantro.

name: Mushroom Lentil Loaf
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; pulse with lentils, oats, walnuts, eggs, half the tomato paste, tamari, thyme.
Press into a loaf pan; glaze with remaining tomato paste.
Bake at 375°F 50 minutes; rest 10.

name: Edamame & Vegetable Soba Bowl
steps: Cook soba; rinse cold.
Whisk tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger.
Toss soba with edamame, vegetables, dressing; sesame.

name: Zucchini Lasagna with Ricotta & Spinach
steps: Slice zucchini; salt, blot, grill briefly. Sauté mushrooms and garlic; add marinara.
Mix ricotta, egg, spinach, seasoning.
Layer zucchini, ricotta, sauce; top cheeses; bake at 375°F 40 minutes.

name: Cauliflower Tikka Masala
steps: Roast cauliflower florets with half the oil and half the spices at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, remaining spices; add tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes; add coconut milk.
Stir in cauliflower, chickpeas, yogurt; garnish cilantro.

name: Greek Zucchini Fritters with Tzatziki
steps: Grate zucchini; salt; squeeze very dry. Mix with eggs, feta, almond flour, green onion, herbs.
Pan-fry spoonfuls in oil 3 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic; serve.

name: Buddha Bowl with Roasted Chickpeas & Tahini
steps: Roast chickpeas, sweet potato, broccoli with oil, paprika, salt at 425°F 22 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic, water.
Bowl quinoa, kale, cabbage, roasted items, avocado; drizzle tahini.

name: Mushroom Stroganoff (Yogurt) over Zoodles
steps: Sear mushrooms in oil until browned; add onion, garlic, thyme, paprika.
Add broth; reduce; stir in yogurt and Dijon off heat.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parsley.

name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Enchilada Skillet
steps: Sauté diced sweet potato in oil covered 8 minutes; add onion, pepper, garlic, cumin.
Add beans and enchilada sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Top cheddar; cover to melt; serve with yogurt, avocado, cilantro.

name: Tofu Banh Mi Lettuce Wraps
steps: Marinate tofu slabs in tamari, garlic, five-spice; pan-fry in oil until crisp.
Quick-pickle carrot and daikon in vinegar 15 minutes.
Fill lettuce with tofu, pickles, cucumber, jalapeño, cilantro, sriracha mayo.

name: Ratatouille with White Beans
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add eggplant, pepper 8 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomato, thyme; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in beans; finish basil.

name: Cottage Cheese Egg Bake with Veggies
steps: Whisk eggs with cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt.
Stir in chopped vegetables and half the cheddar; pour into oiled dish.
Top remaining cheddar; bake at 350°F 35–40 minutes.

name: Lentil Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Sauté onion, garlic; add lentils, seasoning, tomato paste, splash of water; cook 6 minutes.
Toss cabbage with lime and half the yogurt.
Fill tortillas with lentils, slaw, avocado, yogurt, cilantro.

name: Tempeh Stir-Fry with Bok Choy
steps: Pan-fry tempeh slices in oil until golden; remove.
Stir-fry shiitake, garlic, ginger; add bok choy 3 minutes.
Return tempeh with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; sesame.

name: Spinach & Feta Stuffed Mushrooms (Meal-Sized)
steps: Brush caps with oil; roast 8 minutes.
Sauté spinach and garlic; mix with feta, ricotta, dill, beans.
Fill; top pine nuts; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Quinoa Black Bean Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop.
Mix quinoa, beans, corn, salsa, cumin, chopped zucchini flesh.
Fill; top cheese; bake at 400°F 25 minutes; cilantro.

name: Egg & Vegetable Curry
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder in oil.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, cauliflower, green beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Add halved eggs; warm; garnish cilantro.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Quinoa Bake
steps: Sauté onion and garlic; steam broccoli.
Mix quinoa, broccoli, yogurt, eggs, milk, Dijon, half the cheddar, salt.
Spread in a dish; top cheddar; bake at 375°F 25 minutes.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Skillet with Feta
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add tomatoes, chickpeas, oregano; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach and olives.
Top feta and lemon.

name: Tofu Pad Thai (Zoodles)
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until crisp; push aside; scramble eggs.
Add zoodles, garlic, tamari, lime, sweetener, sriracha; toss 2 minutes.
Add sprouts, green onion; top peanuts, cilantro.
